title: Una transformación histórica
goal: Read why historians can't agree on a single word for 1492 or on how many people lived in the Americas before it, and explain what the Virgin of Guadalupe reveals about cultural blending.

items: Explain why 'descubrimiento', 'encuentro' and 'invasión' are all contested terms.
Explain why pre-1492 population estimates vary so widely between historians.
Describe why the Virgin of Guadalupe is considered an example of religious syncretism.
Explain why none of these historical debates has a simple, settled answer.
Use relative clauses with que, a quienes and cuyo/cuya to add precise information.
